value.rationale: The balanced four-by-six multiple chessboard is an intrinsic finite topology object adjacent to the seven-column torsion threshold, with its nonequivariant rank-five H5 already established. The three-to-two-subset incidence kernel is the canonical rank-five S6 integer lattice realizing the same rational Specht module.
